question: Cross-sectional discrimination of MCI from cognitively normal community-dwelling older adults in China, using plasma exosomal RNA (the fluid-biomarker channel). P-1232 is a Guangzhou community case-control study: MCI by Petersen criteria operationalised with education-specific MMSE cut-offs, dementia excluded, 150 v 150 in the qRT-PCR set. P-1254 comes from a Gansu community survey: MCI by MoCA < 26 plus European Consortium criteria, 24 MCI v 24 controls over 65. The markers differ (three lncRNAs combined in P-1232, single miRNAs in P-1254); condition 1 allows this as a difference in features within the channel.

figures.P-1232: Three-lncRNA logistic combination (LINC001380, ENST00000484033, ENST00000531087): AUC 0.700, printed 95% CI 0.641-0.760, sens 72.0%, spec 60.7%, 150 MCI v 150 controls. The printed interval matches Hanley-McNeil at 150/150: Q1 = 0.5385, Q2 = 0.5765, SE = 0.0300, CI [0.641, 0.759].

matched_figure_check: No matched figure exists. Neither study measures the other's markers, and neither reports a result under the other's case definition or control group. P-1232's external AddNeuroMed analysis (AUC 0.695) tests two target genes, ATP2A2 and PSEN1, not the lncRNA panel. P-1254's other contrasts use controls under 65. Nothing in either paper dissolves the gap.
performance_validity: The exclusion does not apply. P-1254's highest AUC is 0.901 and its accuracy at the reported operating point is 43/48 = 0.896, both below 0.97; its 100% specificity is not the exclusion's metric. The 24 v 24 sample, the missing CI, the choice of markers from four candidates and the lack of any cross-validation or external cohort are caveats, not the exclusion. P-1232 (AUC 0.700) is not near ceiling.

candidate_explanations.difference: Different predictor: a logistic combination of three lncRNAs against a single miRNA. Each study measures only its own markers.
candidate_explanations.quote: the AUC of ROC curves for the combination of plasma exosomal LINC001380, ENST00000484033 and ENST00000531087 was 70.0 % (CI: 64.1 %–76.0 %, P < 0.001)

candidate_explanations.difference: Marker selection and optimism. P-1254 chose its miRNAs from four literature candidates, reported ROC only for the two that separated the groups, and evaluated them in-sample on 48 people, with no cross-validation or CI.
candidate_explanations.quote: Based on the amassed evidence, we have selected miRNA-132-3p, −206, −483- 5p, and 502-5p as prospective candidates.
As the biomarker exploration cohort, 24 MCI patients and 24 age- matched controls were chosen at random.

candidate_explanations.difference: Control group. P-1254's 'age-matched' controls averaged about 4.8 years younger than its MCI group (73.35 v 78.12), and the paper reports an age trend in an exosomal marker. P-1232's controls were matched 1:1.
candidate_explanations.quote: CD9 showed an increasing trend dependent on age.

candidate_explanations.difference: Label definition: education-specific MMSE cut-offs (P-1232, case mean MMSE 18.46) against MoCA < 26 plus European Consortium criteria (P-1254, case mean MoCA 20.37).
candidate_explanations.quote: MCI was determined using an education-specific cut-off point for the MMSE total score. MMSE ≤17 for illiterate, MMSE ≤20 for primary school education, and MMSE ≤24 for secondary school and above.

candidate_explanations.difference: Cohort: a Guangzhou (south China) community case-control sample against a Gansu (north-west China) community survey.
candidate_explanations.quote: The recruitment of participants for this case-control study was completed in the community of Guangzhou City, Guangdong Province from January 2018 to December 2022.

reason: Both studies ask whether plasma exosomal RNA separates community-dwelling Chinese older adults with MCI from controls, and both report in-sample AUC. P-1232's printed interval (0.641-0.760) excludes P-1254's 0.901. P-1254's derived Hanley-McNeil interval (0.810-0.992) excludes 0.700, and even its weaker marker (0.872, interval 0.769-0.975) clears P-1232's interval. No matched figure exists, and neither result is near ceiling. The candidate explanations are the different markers, P-1254's post-selection in-sample estimate on 48 people, its younger controls, the case definitions and the cohorts; neither paper shows that any of them is sufficient.
